traps: requirements.in is the declaration, requirements.txt is the compiled lock: asgiref, sqlparse and tzdata are transitive ('# via django'), not declared
the pip-compile header gives the interpreter (Python 3.12) and nothing else about tooling versions
dev-requirements.in constrains itself with -c requirements.txt: the file is a constraint, not a dependency
a reader of requirements.txt alone sees four 'direct' packages
Django is a framework of this project (site/settings.py is a settings module) even without manage.py
no file states a project name: the unit name is null (the folder name is not a name)
